clock_chronotype.desc: CLOCK 3111C allele frequency: 26%. Affects circadian rhythm and meal timing response.

lepr_satiety.desc: LEPR Q223R G allele frequency: 45%. Affects leptin receptor function and satiety signaling.

bdnf_fat_appetite.desc: BDNF Val66Met Met allele frequency: 20%. Affects appetite regulation specifically in response to dietary fat.

cd36_fat_taste.desc: CD36 A allele frequency: 48%. Affects oral fat taste receptor sensitivity.
cd36_fat_taste.notes: AA genotype (~25% Europeans) have higher fat detection thresholds. They may need to consciously track fat intake rather than relying on taste satisfaction.

fads2_vegetarian.desc: FADS2 insertion allele frequency: 38%. Represents positive selection for plant-to-animal fatty acid conversion in populations with long vegetarian traditions.

clock_chronotype.desc: CLOCK 3111C allele frequency: 35%. Affects circadian rhythm and meal timing response.
clock_chronotype.notes: Evening chronotypes gain more weight from late eating. Eating the same calories earlier in the day produces better metabolic outcomes.

per1_meal_timing.desc: PER1 rs2735611 frequency: 32%. Affects response to meal timing consistency.
per1_meal_timing.notes: PER1 regulates circadian rhythms. High responders benefit significantly from eating at the same times daily.

dao_histamine.desc: DAO rs2052129 T allele frequency: 22%. Affects diamine oxidase activity and histamine breakdown.
dao_histamine.notes: DAO enzyme breaks down dietary histamine. Low activity causes headaches, flushing, GI symptoms after high-histamine foods. Fresh foods are safer than aged/fermented.

adora2a_caffeine_anxiety.desc: ADORA2A rs5751876 frequency: 38%. Affects adenosine receptor sensitivity to caffeine (separate from metabolism speed).

tbc1d4_diabetes.notes: Exercise is especially critical for carriers - preserves glucose uptake despite insulin resistance. Traditional high-fat marine diet is metabolically optimal.

cyp2r1_vitamin_d.desc: CYP2R1 A allele frequency: 42%. Affects liver 25-hydroxylation of vitamin D.
cyp2r1_vitamin_d.notes: AG/GG genotypes are 3.7x more likely to be vitamin D insufficient despite sun exposure.

vdr_response.desc: VDR TaqI C allele frequency: 45%. Affects vitamin D receptor sensitivity.
vdr_response.notes: CC genotype may require >2000 IU/day for optimal bone health and immune function.

mtr_b12_methylation.desc: MTR A2756G G allele frequency: 20%. Affects B12-dependent homocysteine remethylation.
mtr_b12_methylation.notes: MTR requires B12 as cofactor. Impaired function increases homocysteine.

mtrr_methylation.desc: MTRR A66G G allele frequency: 55%. Affects MTR regeneration and B12 recycling.
mtrr_methylation.notes: MTRR regenerates MTR enzyme. GG genotype has high methylmalonic acid - monitor in pregnancy.

comt_methylation.desc: COMT Met allele frequency: 50%. Affects catecholamine and estrogen metabolism.
comt_methylation.notes: Slow COMT benefits from cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, kale) which support estrogen clearance via alternative pathways.

cyp11b2_hypertension.desc: CYP11B2 T allele frequency: 35%. Affects aldosterone synthase and sodium retention.
cyp11b2_hypertension.notes: CYP11B2 regulates aldosterone production. T allele increases salt sensitivity and hypertension risk.

agtr1_hypertension.desc: AGTR1 T allele frequency: 45%. Affects angiotensin II receptor type 1 activity.
agtr1_hypertension.notes: AGTR1 mediates vasoconstriction. High activity benefits from potassium-rich foods (bananas, leafy greens, potatoes).

lepr_satiety.desc: LEPR Q223R G allele frequency: 48%. Affects leptin receptor function and satiety signaling.
lepr_satiety.notes: GG homozygotes have impaired leptin signaling, leading to reduced satiety. Regular meal timing and protein-rich foods may help.

bdnf_fat_appetite.desc: BDNF Val66Met Met allele frequency: 20%. Affects appetite regulation specifically in response to dietary fat.
bdnf_fat_appetite.notes: BDNF Met carriers do NOT show hyperphagia on low-fat or high-sucrose diets - the effect is FAT-SPECIFIC. Low-fat diet is the targeted intervention.

cd36_fat_taste.desc: CD36 A allele frequency: 50%. Affects oral fat taste receptor sensitivity.
cd36_fat_taste.notes: AA genotype (~25% Europeans) have higher fat detection thresholds. They may need to consciously track fat intake rather than relying on taste satisfaction.

fads2_vegetarian.desc: FADS2 insertion allele frequency: 18%. Represents positive selection for plant-to-animal fatty acid conversion in populations with long vegetarian traditions.
fads2_vegetarian.notes: High converters efficiently make EPA/DHA from plants but also convert omega-6 to inflammatory arachidonic acid. Traditional South Asian diets with mustard oil and ghee are more compatible than Western vegetable oil-heavy diets.

clock_chronotype.desc: CLOCK 3111C allele frequency: 30%. Affects circadian rhythm and meal timing response.
clock_chronotype.notes: Evening chronotypes gain more weight from late eating. Eating the same calories earlier in the day produces better metabolic outcomes.

per1_meal_timing.desc: PER1 rs2735611 frequency: 40%. Affects response to meal timing consistency.
per1_meal_timing.notes: PER1 regulates circadian rhythms. High responders benefit significantly from eating at the same times daily.

dao_histamine.desc: DAO rs2052129 T allele frequency: 28%. Affects diamine oxidase activity and histamine breakdown.
dao_histamine.notes: DAO enzyme breaks down dietary histamine. Low activity causes headaches, flushing, GI symptoms after high-histamine foods. Fresh foods are safer than aged/fermented.

adora2a_caffeine_anxiety.desc: ADORA2A rs5751876 frequency: 48%. Affects adenosine receptor sensitivity to caffeine (separate from metabolism speed).

abcg2_gout.desc: ABCG2 rs2231142 T allele frequency: 9%. Affects uric acid transport - dysfunction leads to hyperuricemia and gout.
abcg2_gout.notes: ABCG2 is a urate transporter. Dysfunction causes uric acid accumulation. Pacific Islanders and Filipinos have highest frequencies globally.

slc2a9_urate.desc: SLC2A9 rs734553 frequency: 75%. Affects renal urate handling. Near-fixed in Pacific Islanders (98-100%).
slc2a9_urate.notes: SLC2A9 affects how kidneys handle uric acid. Combined with ABCG2 variants, explains extremely high gout rates in Pacific Islander populations.

ashkenazi_ldlr_fh.desc: LDLR G197del carrier frequency: 0.35%. Causes familial hypercholesterolemia (FH).
ashkenazi_ldlr_fh.notes: FH causes very high LDL from birth. Heterozygotes have 2-3x normal LDL. Early statin therapy dramatically reduces cardiovascular events. Diet alone is usually insufficient for FH.

mthfr_folate.desc: MTHFR 677T allele frequency: 34%. Moderate prevalence of reduced enzyme activity.
mthfr_folate.notes: MTHFR C677T T allele: 34%. TT genotype (~11% of population) has significantly reduced enzyme function.

fto_obesity.desc: FTO rs9939609 A allele frequency: 42%. Higher frequency of reduced satiety signaling.
fto_obesity.notes: FTO rs9939609 A allele: 42%. The POUNDS LOST trial confirmed protein-satiety interaction.

hfe_iron_overload.desc: HFE C282Y allele frequency: 5.8%. Elevated risk of hereditary hemochromatosis in this population.
hfe_iron_overload.notes: HFE C282Y: 5.8%. This variant is largely European-specific. ~5-10% of European-descent homozygotes develop clinical hemochromatosis.

tas2r38_bitter.desc: TAS2R38 PAV taster haplotype frequency: 45%. Balanced distribution of tasters and non-tasters.
tas2r38_bitter.notes: TAS2R38 PAV frequency: 45%. PAV/PAV supertasters (~20%) perceive PROP/PTC as intensely bitter.

tcf7l2_diabetes.desc: TCF7L2 rs7903146 T allele frequency: 30%. Elevated genetic risk for type 2 diabetes in this population.

clock_chronotype.desc: CLOCK 3111C allele frequency: 26%. Affects circadian rhythm and meal timing response.

per1_meal_timing.notes: PER1 regulates circadian rhythms. High responders benefit significantly from eating at the same times daily.

arctic_fat_metabolism.notes: Strong positive selection in Arctic populations. Traditional high-fat marine diet is optimal for carriers.

vdr_response.desc: VDR TaqI C allele frequency: 38%. Affects vitamin D receptor sensitivity.
vdr_response.notes: CC genotype may require >2000 IU/day for optimal bone health and immune function.

mtrr_methylation.desc: MTRR A66G G allele frequency: 42%. Affects MTR regeneration and B12 recycling.
mtrr_methylation.notes: MTRR regenerates MTR enzyme. GG genotype has high methylmalonic acid - monitor in pregnancy.

comt_methylation.desc: COMT Met allele frequency: 40%. Affects catecholamine and estrogen metabolism.
comt_methylation.notes: Slow COMT benefits from cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, kale) which support estrogen clearance via alternative pathways.

cyp11b2_hypertension.desc: CYP11B2 T allele frequency: 40%. Affects aldosterone synthase and sodium retention.
cyp11b2_hypertension.notes: CYP11B2 regulates aldosterone production. T allele increases salt sensitivity and hypertension risk.

agtr1_hypertension.desc: AGTR1 T allele frequency: 45%. Affects angiotensin II receptor type 1 activity.

lepr_satiety.desc: LEPR Q223R G allele frequency: 40%. Affects leptin receptor function and satiety signaling.

bdnf_fat_appetite.desc: BDNF Val66Met Met allele frequency: 20%. Affects appetite regulation specifically in response to dietary fat.

cd36_fat_taste.desc: CD36 A allele frequency: 42%. Affects oral fat taste receptor sensitivity.

per1_meal_timing.desc: PER1 rs2735611 frequency: 32%. Affects response to meal timing consistency.
per1_meal_timing.notes: PER1 regulates circadian rhythms. High responders benefit significantly from eating at the same times daily.

lepr_satiety.desc: LEPR Q223R G allele frequency: 36%. Affects leptin receptor function and satiety signaling.

hfe_iron_overload.notes: HFE C282Y: 5.8%. This variant is largely European-specific. ~5-10% of European-descent homozygotes develop clinical hemochromatosis.

tas2r38_bitter.desc: TAS2R38 PAV taster haplotype frequency: 45%. Balanced distribution of tasters and non-tasters.
tas2r38_bitter.notes: TAS2R38 PAV frequency: 45%. PAV/PAV supertasters (~20%) perceive PROP/PTC as intensely bitter.

tcf7l2_diabetes.desc: TCF7L2 rs7903146 T allele frequency: 30%. Elevated genetic risk for type 2 diabetes in this population.
tcf7l2_diabetes.notes: TCF7L2 rs7903146 T allele: 30%. Strongest common genetic predictor of T2DM risk. Diet-gene interaction well-documented.

bco1_vitamin_a.desc: BCO1 rs12934922 T allele frequency: 42%. Higher proportion of poor beta-carotene converters.
bco1_vitamin_a.notes: BCO1 rs12934922 T allele: 42%. Up to 45% of population may be poor converters. Especially important for plant-based diets.

mc4r_appetite.desc: MC4R rs17782313 C allele frequency: 24%. Moderate prevalence of appetite-affecting variants.
mc4r_appetite.notes: MC4R rs17782313 C allele: 24%. Second strongest obesity GWAS signal after FTO. Meta-analysis of 48,560 participants confirms appetite association.

ace_salt_sensitivity.desc: ACE I/D D allele frequency: 54%. Mixed distribution of salt sensitivity genotypes.
ace_salt_sensitivity.notes: ACE D allele: 54%. The I/D polymorphism is a 287bp Alu insertion/deletion. Strongest single-gene predictor of salt-sensitive blood pressure response.

nat2_acetylator.desc: NAT2 slow acetylator phenotype frequency: 58%. Majority are slow acetylators.
nat2_acetylator.notes: NAT2 slow acetylator frequency: 58%. Phenotype frequency used (not single SNP). East Asians have lowest slow acetylator rates (~10-25%); Europeans/Africans highest (~50-70%).

lipc_hdl.desc: LIPC rs1800588 T allele: 21%. Higher hepatic lipase activity common.
lipc_hdl.notes: LIPC T allele: 21%. Framingham Study showed strong gene-diet interaction with dietary fat.

ppara_pufa.desc: PPARA rs1800206 Val162 allele: 6%. Some individuals need higher PUFA.
ppara_pufa.notes: PPARA Val162: 6%. Rare but highly actionable. STOP-NIDDM trial showed 1.9x diabetes risk is diet-modifiable.

drd2_food_reward.desc: DRD2 rs1800497 A1 allele: 19%. Most have normal D2 receptor density.
drd2_food_reward.notes: DRD2 A1 allele: 19%. Associated with food addiction patterns and preference for fried/sugary foods.

gc_vitamin_d.desc: GC rs2282679 C allele: 27%. More individuals with lower vitamin D binding.
gc_vitamin_d.notes: GC C allele: 27%. Encodes vitamin D binding protein. Combined with CYP2R1 for vitamin D genetic risk score.

pemt_choline.desc: PEMT rs12325817 C allele: 75%. Reduced endogenous choline synthesis common.
pemt_choline.notes: PEMT C allele: 75%. ~75% carry at least one C allele. Sex-specific effect - women more vulnerable to deficiency.

fabp2_fat_absorption.desc: FABP2 rs1799883 Thr54 allele: 29%. Mixed fat absorption genetics.
fabp2_fat_absorption.notes: FABP2 Thr54: 29%. Well-replicated from Pima Indians through Finnish and Japanese populations.

tmprss6_iron.desc: TMPRSS6 rs855791 T allele: 55%. Lower iron absorption common.
tmprss6_iron.notes: TMPRSS6 T allele: 55%. Modulates hepcidin regulation. TT individuals absorb 30% less iron than CC.

agt_salt.desc: AGT rs699 T allele: 42%. Lower prevalence of salt-sensitive variant.
agt_salt.notes: AGT T allele: 42%. T is ancestral allele (high in African populations). Over 300 epidemiological studies support salt-BP link.

adrb2_weight_loss.desc: ADRB2 rs1042714 Glu27 allele: 43%. Many respond well to energy restriction.
adrb2_weight_loss.notes: ADRB2 Glu27: 43%. Meta-analysis of 18 studies (n=9,995) confirms obesity association.

tas1r2_sweet.desc: TAS1R2 rs35874116 T allele: 65%. ~42% TT with reduced sweet discrimination.
tas1r2_sweet.notes: TAS1R2 T allele: 65%. Sweet taste receptor gene. Effect strongest in those with BMI≥25.

oprm1_food_reward.desc: OPRM1 rs1799971 G allele: 16%. Some enhanced food reward genetics.
oprm1_food_reward.notes: OPRM1 G allele: 16%. Dramatic population variation (2% African to 40% East Asian). Combined with DRD2 predicts binge eating.

adrb3_thermogenesis.desc: ADRB3 rs4994 Arg64 allele: 8%. Most have normal thermogenesis.
adrb3_thermogenesis.notes: ADRB3 Arg64: 8%. Meta-analyses confirm childhood obesity association, especially in East Asians.

irs1_insulin.desc: IRS1 rs2943641 C allele: 63%. Mixed insulin signaling genetics.
irs1_insulin.notes: IRS1 C allele: 63%. POUNDS LOST trial (n=738) validated diet-gene interaction across European and Puerto Rican populations.

pparg_adipocyte.desc: PPARG rs1801282 Ala12 allele: 12%. Some have T2DM protection variant.
pparg_adipocyte.notes: PPARG Ala12: 12%. Meta-analysis of 73 studies (131,863 subjects) confirms T2DM association. Nearly absent in African populations.

ugt1a1_fasting.desc: UGT1A1 *28 allele: 32%. Some Gilbert's syndrome genetics.
ugt1a1_fasting.notes: UGT1A1 *28: 32%. Gilbert's affects ~5-10% of population. Fasting, infection, stress trigger mild jaundice.

slc23a1_vitamin_c.notes: 1000G CEU A=6.1%, GBR A=4.4%; highest A allele frequency globally in CEU

atp7a_copper.notes: ALSPAC T=41.8%, TWINSUK T=42.5%, GoNL T=42.7%

pcsk9_ldl.notes: gnomAD European 2.0% (genomes, n=78,676); 1000G CEU ~2.1%, GBR ~2.0%. Highest R46L frequency globally

apoa1_hdl.notes: 1000G CEU/GBR ~15-17%; UK ALSPAC 16.6%

ldlr_cholesterol.notes: 1000G CEU C allele ~63%, GBR ~64%; gnomAD non-Finnish EUR ~63%

lpl_triglycerides.notes: 1000G CEU ~10.1%, GBR ~10.4%; Dutch GoNL 11.8%; UK ALSPAC 10.7%

pon1_antioxidant.desc: R allele (rs662): 28%. Post-agricultural European diet of wheat, dairy, wine, olive oil, and diverse animal proteins.

gckr_carb_sensitivity.desc: T allele (P446L): 40%. Post-agricultural European diet of wheat, dairy, wine, olive oil, and diverse animal proteins.

fgf21_carb_preference.desc: A allele (rs838133): 55%. Post-agricultural European diet of wheat, dairy, wine, olive oil, and diverse animal proteins.

apoa5_triglycerides.desc: C allele (-1131C): 8%. Post-agricultural European diet of wheat, dairy, wine, olive oil, and diverse animal proteins.

slc6a4_serotonin.desc: S allele (5-HTTLPR): 43%. Post-agricultural European diet of wheat, dairy, wine, olive oil, and diverse animal proteins.

hnmt_histamine.desc: T allele (Ile105): 12%. Post-agricultural European diet of wheat, dairy, wine, olive oil, and diverse animal proteins.

cyp4f2_vitamin_e.desc: M allele (V433M): 27%. Post-agricultural European diet of wheat, dairy, wine, olive oil, and diverse animal proteins.

apoc3_omega3_response.desc: C2 haplotype: 28%. Post-agricultural European diet of wheat, dairy, wine, olive oil, and diverse animal proteins.

cyp19a1_phytoestrogen.desc: T allele (rs10046): 50%. Post-agricultural European diet of wheat, dairy, wine, olive oil, and diverse animal proteins.

alcohol_metabolism.notes: Low fast ADH1B allele; standard European pattern. Normal alcohol metabolism.

pufa_metabolism.notes: Moderate FADS1 conversion efficiency consistent with Northern/Western European range.
